PWD.description: Optional project or workspace root used by the PWD convention. Accepts absolute POSIX, drive-letter, UNC, and translated Windows device paths such as /repo, D:\work, D:/work, or //?/D:/work. Empty or non-directory values are treated as absent; when absent, every file path must already be absolute.

file.description: Use the file path you already selected. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. When PWD resolves to an existing directory, relative file values are resolved from that root; otherwise file must already be absolute. Passing a directory is only for a quick direct-child Name listing; use vulcan-file-list for recursive discovery.

segments.description: Preferred structured line-range input. Each item uses a 1-based start line and a positive count. Omit this field to read from the file start using the host file-read budget. Do not pass this field together with lines_rule.

start.description: 1-based first line to read for this segment.

count.description: Number of lines to read starting from start.

lines_rule.description: Legacy fallback for clients that cannot send arrays. Use LF newline-separated start,count segments such as "5,10\n25,30". Omit this field when segments is provided.

files.description: Use for batch file reads. Provide up to 10 items, each with file and optional segments, lines_rule, or numbered overrides. Do not send this field together with root-level single-file read arguments.

file.description: Use the file path you already selected for this batch item. Relative paths require a valid root-level PWD. Directory paths are allowed only for quick direct-child Name listings.

segments.description: Preferred structured line-range input for this batch item.

start.description: 1-based first line to read for this segment.

count.description: Number of lines to read starting from start.

lines_rule.description: Legacy fallback for this batch item when the client cannot send arrays.

numbered.description: Override the root numbered setting for this batch item only.

Keep true when you will cite or edit by line number. Set false only when raw text lines without L<number>: prefixes are more useful; the metadata header and multi-segment separators still remain. In batch mode this value acts as the default for all items unless an item overrides it.
